name: effect-fence-hold-grant-preempted-peer-write-acquire
description: HOLD reason `grant_preempted`, the last leg. Session A reads (SHARED), then peer session B acquires the write claim via /hooks/pre-edit. A peer's pessimistic acquire ends the holder's grant while moving NEITHER comparand -- no commit has landed so the version stays 1, and trigger="write" is outside EPOCH_BUMP_TRIGGERS so the ownership generation stays 0. Session A therefore fences with BOTH comparands confirmed and unchanged and still must hold. This is the only leg that can see a preemption, which is exactly why the request body here is identical to 01's PROCEED body: the difference between fire and hold is one preflight request, and a regression that dropped the grant_did_not_stand leg would make this fixture answer `proceed`.
